data.name: Dhohanth
data.gender_notes: Dhohanth is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dhana’, meaning wealth. The prefix ‘dhoh’ signifies the one who is blessed with it. This name is believed to bring good fortune and prosperity in one's life. The name Dhohanth carries the meaning “Blessed with prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dhohanth usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed with prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Dhohanth belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blessed with prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhohanth total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
